instructions.allowed_edits: Coding agents may update only status, evidence, and notes fields unless the user explicitly changes scope.
instructions.completion_rule: A feature is passing only after end-to-end evidence exists.

features.description: Production Supabase project is active and the Vercel Supabase proxy returns readable Auth and Edge Function responses.
steps: Confirm the project ref used by production is reachable at https://zjkbktdmwencnouwfrij.supabase.co.
Confirm https://www.uuedu.online/api/supabase/auth/v1/health returns 200 with the configured anon key.
Confirm the production proxy does not forward stale compression headers that break JSON body parsing.
Confirm production smoke passes after deployment.
features.evidence: Supabase project misaya-yang's Project was resumed from paused state; npm run smoke:prod passed 8/8 on https://www.uuedu.online; commit a766cf1 deployed as Vercel dpl_5LxAb5cj72MRod4coXbGpMatvxGq; registration and login API probes returned HTTP 200 with user/access_token.
features.notes: No new Supabase project was created. Old project ref zjkbktdmwencnouwfrij remains the production ref.

features.description: A real user can register, log in, reload, and enter the dashboard without relying on the demo account.
steps: Create a timestamped test account through the production registration UI.
Log out or use a fresh browser context, then log in with that account through the production login UI.
Verify the dashboard opens, reload keeps the session, and Supabase refresh does not storm.
Verify invalid credentials produce a readable inline error and do not fall back to a fake success state.
features.evidence: Production UI check created 3 synthetic accounts through https://www.uuedu.online/register. Each account registered into /dashboard/today, logged in from a fresh context through /login, and stayed on /dashboard/today after reload. Invalid-credential check stayed on /login and showed a readable error. A later production revalidation created 3 additional synthetic accounts and all 3 passed registration, fresh-context login, and reload persistence with 0 console errors and 0 failed Supabase requests.
features.notes: Do not print test account emails, passwords, or tokens. Earlier page-transition profile aborts were not blocking; the latest production revalidation showed no failed Supabase requests.

features.description: Dark mode is readable, restrained, non-glowy, and does not flash black blocks during theme or route changes.
steps: Audit light, dark, and system theme initialization before paint.
Check dashboard route switching for full-screen black surfaces or long skeletons.
Capture desktop 1440x960 and mobile 390x844 screenshots.
Verify contrast of buttons, cards, form labels, feedback panels, and loading states.
features.evidence: VD-02 changed dark tokens, theme pre-paint versioning, and regression checks. Local learning-flow regression passed 142/142 across desktop 1440x960, mobile 390x844, light/dark/system, route switching, Practice retry/reveal, and listening retry/reveal. Production deployment dpl_vNSef9xouqZ7NS5LdEbHfwe4LZZQ is Ready and aliased to https://www.uuedu.online. Production smoke passed 8/8. Production logged-in UI check created a synthetic account, logged in through /login, and passed 25/25 light/dark/system desktop/mobile checks for /, /dashboard/today, /dashboard/practice, and fast dashboard route switching. Dark background is rgb(63,67,75), brightness 67, overflow 0. Stale dark preferences migrate to light before render.
features.notes: VD-02 fixes the dark-mode foundation only. Remaining visual/product issues are scheduled for VD-03 Product UI Redesign.

features.description: Core app screens stop reading as an AI template and become a focused English learning workspace with clear layout and plain copy.
steps: Inventory every public page and dashboard route named in the phase contract.
Remove AI-sounding copy and unclear labels from primary workflows.
Rebuild information hierarchy for Today, Practice, Review, Chat, Analytics, Profile, Settings, and learning modules.
Verify desktop and mobile layouts have no overlap, horizontal overflow, card nesting, or clipped button text.
features.notes: Do not start this phase until VD-02 has stabilized visual tokens and loading states.

features.description: VocabDaily ships an IELTS-oriented Anki-style card foundation that adds practical study value beyond generic practice screens.
steps: Define a first IELTS card schema with word, meaning, part of speech, collocations, example, Chinese hint, difficulty, and review tags.
Seed a first deck that is useful without external imports.
Wire the deck into existing review/practice flows without breaking FSRS or current word data.
Add tests for card shape, deck availability, and at least one UI entry point.
features.notes: This phase must not invent fake expert claims or fake precision. Content should be useful and inspectable.
